name: v0.9.0
body:
## What's Changed

### TL;DR

* Concurrent requests of one session keep their own answers, session changes and fibers
* The client fails fast instead of waiting out its timeout
* Authorization narrows to the resource server role
* stdio and the client speak both protocol eras

### Server

* Concurrent requests and sessions
  * Add an opt-in per-session lock, `Builder::setSessionLock()`, serializing the concurrent requests of one session so none of them overwrites what another saved. `FileSessionLock` locks with `flock()` next to `FileSessionStore`, whose `gc()` also removes stale lock files; `SymfonyLockSessionLock` uses a symfony/lock store for sessions shared across machines; `SessionLockInterface` takes custom ones. A request that cannot get the lock in time, or hits a failing lock backend, is answered with `503` and a JSON-RPC error (`SessionLockTimeoutException` and `SessionLockException`). `Protocol::__construct()` takes the lock as optional last argument.
  * Fix concurrent requests of one session overwriting each other's session changes: `Session::save()` writes only the keys it changed, onto what the store holds at that point. Writes of a handler after it resumed from an elicitation, sampling request or notification are saved too, and a session deleted while one of its requests still ran no longer comes back when that request saves it.
  * Fix an unreachable `Psr16SessionStore` cache being answered as "session not found" (`404`): the failure is logged and answered with `503`, so clients retry instead of re-initializing. `SessionStoreInterface::exists()` may throw the new `SessionStoreException`.
  * Fix parallel calls of one session getting each other's elicitation answers and progress tokens: each stream polls only the client request its own fiber sent, requests to the client get UUID ids instead of a session counter, and `ClientGateway::progress()` takes the token from its own request.
  * Fix concurrent stdio tool calls that report progress, log, elicit or sample never finishing: `StdioTransport` keeps every suspended fiber and resumes each with the answer to its own request. A call's notifications now go out before its response.
  * [BC Break] Ids of requests to the client are UUIDs: `Protocol::sendRequest()`, `Protocol::checkResponse()` and `Protocol::handleFiberYield()` take and return a `Uuid` instead of an `int`, as does the response finder of a transport; `handleFiberYield()` returns the id of the request it sent. A transport passes the suspended `\Fiber` as last argument to the pending-requests provider and the fiber yield handler, and `StreamableHttpTransport::handleFiberTermination()` takes the terminated `\Fiber` as its first argument.
  * [BC Break] Fix lost responses on concurrent requests of one session over Streamable HTTP: a POST is answered with its own responses instead of taking them from the session's outgoing queue. `TransportInterface::send()` receives every response of a handler that does not suspend, and the outgoing queue only carries server-initiated requests and notifications; a custom transport must deliver each message it gets, as a batch gets several.
  * Fix `StreamableHttpTransport` bundling the session's queued messages (e.g. `notifications/resources/updated`) with a request's response into a JSON array, which clients on `2025-06-18` and later reject: such a request is answered as SSE, the queued messages first. A POST of only responses or notifications is accepted with `202` and no body, and the queued messages stay.
  * Fix requests to the client (elicitation, sampling) staying in the session's pending requests after they timed out or their stream vanished: `Protocol::checkResponse()` expires them with the `Request timed out` error, entries of a vanished stream are dropped a minute past their timeout, and an answer to a request the server is not waiting on is dropped instead of stored.
  * Fix a handler throwing after its fiber resumed escaping to the transport: it is answered with an error response, like one throwing before suspending. A suspended handler is resumed with an error instead of `null` when the transport fails to store what it sends to the client; `ClientGateway::notify()` then throws a `ClientException`.
  * Fix a handshake-era Streamable HTTP stream pinning its PHP worker until the elicitation (or other client request) times out after the client disconnected: the idle stream sends a keep-alive comment and stops once the connection is aborted.
* Authorization and HTTP security
  * [BC Break] Narrow authorization to the resource server role (ADR 0002): remove `OAuthProxyMiddleware`, `ClientRegistrationMiddleware`, `ClientRegistrarInterface`, `ClientRegistrationException`, `JwksProvider`, `JwksProviderInterface`, `OidcDiscoveryInterface` and the OIDC metadata policies; `OidcDiscovery` is internal.
  * [BC Break] Replace `OAuthRequestMetaMiddleware` with `RequestContext::getAccessToken()`, returning the validated `Server\Authorization\AccessToken`; `AuthorizationResult::allow()` takes an `AccessToken` instead of request attributes. `Protocol::processInput()`, `BaseTransport::handleMessage()` and `StreamableHttpTransport::handlePostRequest()` take an `?AccessToken $accessToken` parameter, as does the `TransportInterface::onMessage()` listener as fourth argument.
  * [BC Break] Make `JwtTokenValidator` final with a single issuer instead of a list of issuer aliases, and a `$keys` set (e.g. `CachedKeySet`); `JwtTokenValidator::fromIssuer()` discovers and caches keys in a PSR-6 pool, refetching on unknown key ids. The `alg` allowlist is enforced, `$tokenType` and `$leeway` are added, `requireScopes()` is removed in favour of `ScopePolicy`.
  * [BC Break] Add `ScopePolicy` as third argument of `AuthorizationMiddleware`, answering `403 insufficient_scope` per method and tool, with scope hierarchies; the `resource_metadata` challenge URL comes from the configured resource instead of the `Host` header.
  * [BC Break] `ProtectedResourceMetadata` requires `$resource`, serves at the path derived from it (RFC 9728 §3.1) and requires https except for loopback hosts; drops localized, policy, ToS, extra fields and `$metadataPaths`.
  * Fix OIDC discovery rejecting issuers with a trailing slash (e.g. Authentik, Auth0).
  * Fix CORS preflight requests failing with `401` behind `AuthorizationMiddleware`, which now lets `OPTIONS` requests pass without a token. The default `CorsMiddleware` allows `Mcp-Method`, `Mcp-Name` and `Mcp-Param-*` and exposes `WWW-Authenticate`; an `$allowedHeaders` entry ending in `*` allows each requested header with that prefix.
  * [BC Break] `DnsRebindingProtectionMiddleware` always validates `Host` (a missing one is rejected) and checks `Origin` separately against the new `allowedOrigins`, including scheme and port and empty by default. Same-origin requests are always allowed and both lists accept `['*']`. `allowedOrigins` is the new second constructor argument; pass the factories by name.
  * Add `PassthroughMiddleware` to opt `StreamableHttpTransport` out of its default middleware without the warning an empty `$middleware` list logs.
* Protocol eras
  * [BC Break] Serve both protocol eras over stdio: `StdioTransport` settles the era on the client's first request and serves `2026-07-28` requests, `subscriptions/listen` and `notifications/cancelled` on the one channel. `StatelessAwareTransportInterface` declares `setHandshakeVersions()`, so a server without the modern era names only the revisions it negotiates when refusing a `2026-07-28` request.
  * Answer a bare `initialize` on a `2026-07-28`-only endpoint with `-32022` naming the served revisions, and a request without a session on the handshake leg with its id.
  * Reject a recognized `Mcp-Param-*` header whose mirrored argument is absent from the body with `-32020`, instead of accepting the request (SEP-2243).
  * [BC Break] Announce `listChanged` only where list changes are delivered: never in the `initialize` result, and on `server/discover` only when the registry publishes them to a notification bus. `RegistryInterface` declares `publishesListChanges()`, which `Registry` answers with `true` when its dispatcher is a `PublishingEventDispatcher`; a decorating registry forwards the answer of the one it wraps.
* Tools and validation
  * [BC Break] Validate a tool result's `structuredContent` against the tool's `outputSchema`, which the specification requires the server to honour. A mismatch is answered with a `CallToolResult` carrying `isError: true` instead of the non-conforming value, matching the TypeScript, Python and Java SDKs. Skipped when the tool declares no `outputSchema`, when the result carries no `structuredContent`, and when the result is already an error. Return `new \stdClass()` for an empty object, since `[]` is sent as an array.
  * [BC Break] Add `Builder::setSchemaValidator()` to configure the validator used for `tools/call` input and output, e.g. with a resolver for external `$ref` schemas. `SchemaValidator` takes an optional `Opis\JsonSchema\Validator` as its first constructor argument, moving `$logger` to second (pass `logger:` by name), and `validateAgainstJsonSchema()` no longer validates an empty array as an object (pass `new \stdClass()`).
  * Fix `SchemaValidator` falling back to opis' wording for camelCase keywords like `minLength`, `multipleOf` or `additionalProperties`, and reporting a pointer relative to the `$ref` target inside `$defs`. Clients now see the SDK's messages and the full pointer.
  * [BC Break] Remove the `providerClass` argument of `#[CompletionProvider]`. Use `provider:`, which takes the same class-string and is now the first positional argument.
* Logging, events and runtime
  * [BC Break] Fix the client's log level being ignored: `ClientGateway::log()` drops messages below the level set with `logging/setLevel`, and below `warning` while the client has set none, and `ClientLogger` honours a lower level a `2026-07-28` request asks for with `io.modelcontextprotocol/logLevel`. `ClientLogger` takes only the `ClientGateway`, which applies the level itself.
  * Stop the server `Protocol` from logging full JSON-RPC payloads (tool arguments, client replies) at info level: info records now carry only the method and id, the raw message is logged at debug level.
  * Fix `RequestEvent`, `ResponseEvent` and `ErrorEvent` not being dispatched for `2026-07-28` requests, and `ResponseEvent` and `ErrorEvent` not when a suspended fiber completes.
  * Add `ServerRequestEvent` and `ClientResponseEvent` for handshake-era server-initiated requests (`elicitation/create`, `sampling/createMessage`) and the client's replies.
  * Fix memory growing with every `tools/call` in long-lived processes like FrankenPHP workers or stdio servers.
  * Fix the server's `StdioTransport` answering a request on an idle connection only after ~50ms: it now waits on the input with `stream_select()` instead of sleeping.
  * Fix stateless SSE streams holding back frames until close when PHP output buffering is enabled.

### Client

* Protocol eras
  * [BC Break] Speak both protocol eras by default: the client's default protocol version is `2026-07-28`, and `connect()` probes with `server/discover` and falls back to the `initialize` handshake on `2025-11-25` when the server does not speak the modern era. `Builder::setFallbackProtocolVersion()` picks the fallback revision, or `null` for a modern-only client. Against a server that speaks both, a default client now settles on `2026-07-28`, where a server can no longer sample or list roots through `ClientGateway`; return those asks as an `InputRequiredResult` instead, or call `Builder::setProtocolVersion(ProtocolVersion::V2025_11_25)` on the client.
  * On a `2026-07-28` connection, `Client::setLoggingLevel()` stamps the level on every following request, `Client::ping()` sends `server/discover` and `Client::sendRootsListChanged()` sends nothing.
  * Add a `listen` option to the client's `HttpTransport`, opening the standalone GET stream on which a 2025-era server sends requests and notifications outside of a client request, like `roots/list`. Needs a PSR-18 client that streams response bodies, such as `symfony/http-client`.
* Failing fast and recovering
  * Fail a client request at once instead of waiting out the timeout when the HTTP server refuses it with an error status, or a non-streamed response ends without its answer (truncated, empty, unreadable or not JSON), also when the body of an error status fails to read.
  * Fix the client after the stdio server process exited: requests fail at once with the exit code and the end of stderr, and `Client::isConnected()` turns false.
  * [BC Break] Fix the client request timeout firing up to a second early and throwing a generic `RequestException`: it now throws `TimeoutException` and sends `notifications/cancelled` for the abandoned request. `TimeoutException` extends `RequestException` instead of `Exception`, so a `catch (RequestException)` now also catches timeouts. `ClientStateInterface::getPendingRequests()` reports `timestamp` as a `float` from `microtime(true)` instead of an `int`.
  * Resume an interrupted SSE response in `HttpTransport` with a GET carrying `Last-Event-ID`, honouring the server's `retry` interval. Configure attempts and fallback backoff with `ReconnectPolicy`, the scheduling clock with any PSR-20 `ClockInterface` (default: a monotonic clock). Protocol version `2026-07-28` does not resume streams. A stream that ends without its response and without an event ID now fails the request instead of waiting for its timeout.
  * Fix a client `onProgress` callback receiving progress for an earlier request that timed out: progress now only reaches the callback of the request whose `progressToken` it carries.
  * Fix `Client::getServerInfo()`, `getInstructions()` and `getProtocolVersion()` reporting the previous server's values after a reconnect, whether it failed or reached a `2026-07-28` server whose `server/discover` leaves them out.
  * Fix `Client::connect()` rejecting an empty `serverInfo.version`, as the Python SDK sends, and leaving the transport open when initialization fails on a malformed result: the transport is now closed and the failure wrapped in a `ConnectionException`.
  * Fix the client's `HttpTransport` failing to connect through an amphp-based PSR-18 client, like Symfony's `Psr18Client(new AmpHttpClient())`, where `connect()` failed at the init timeout with `FutureIterator::consume(): Return value must be of type ?array`: requests are now sent from outside the request fiber, where the event loop runs.
* API
  * [BC Break] Add `Client::getServerCapabilities()`, returning what the server declared in `initialize` or, from `2026-07-28` on, in `server/discover`. `ClientStateInterface` declares `setServerCapabilities()` and `getServerCapabilities()`, and its `setProtocolVersion()` and `setServerInfo()` accept `null`, which a custom implementation has to follow.
  * Add `HttpTransport::getSessionId()` to read the server-minted `Mcp-Session-Id`: a request-scoped caller can persist it and pass it back through the constructor's `$headers` on a later transport. Always `null` on `2026-07-28`, which removed protocol-level sessions.
  * Fix `HttpTransport` omitting the `MCP-Protocol-Version` header on requests after the `initialize` handshake, including the closing `DELETE`.
  * Fix `Client::getPrompt()` without arguments sending `"arguments": []`, which servers validating the spec's object type (e.g. the TypeScript SDK) reject: empty arguments are now omitted.
  * Fix the client throwing a native `\JsonException` for request params it cannot encode (e.g. invalid UTF-8): it now throws `InvalidArgumentException`, and a request handler result it cannot encode is answered with an internal error instead of no answer.

### Schema

* [BC Break] Bump `MessageInterface::PROTOCOL_VERSION` to `2026-07-28`. Use `ProtocolVersion::latestHandshake()` where a handshake revision is needed, e.g. in an `initialize` answer.
* Add `Tool::$execution` (`ToolExecution` with a `TaskSupport` enum) and `ServerCapabilities::$tasks`, which were dropped when parsing a 2025-11-25 server's `tools/list` and `initialize` results.
* [BC Break] Reject a `Tool` input schema whose `properties` is not an object or whose `required` is neither a list nor `null`, instead of silently replacing the member. Reject a `completion/complete` whose `argument` is missing `name` or `value`, instead of completing against an empty prefix.
* [BC Break] Add `ElicitationSchema::getDefaults()`, returning the declared `default` of each field to accept a form elicitation with. `AbstractSchemaDefinition` declares an abstract `getDefault()`, which a custom schema definition has to implement.

## New Contributors
* @RobLoach made their first contribution in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/497
* @karedum made their first contribution in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/506
* @SammyTourani made their first contribution in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/520
* @steffans made their first contribution in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/509
* @aton-of-data made their first contribution in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/525
* @mglaman made their first contribution in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/526
* @guillaume-sainthillier made their first contribution in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/535
* @ez-lbz made their first contribution in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/425
* @Arslan-TR made their first contribution in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/585
* @ausi made their first contribution in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/589
* @vbcherepanov made their first contribution in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/584

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/compare/v0.8.1...v0.9.0

name: v0.8.0
body:
# 2026-07-28 Support incl. Stateless HTTP Transport

With v0.8.0 we are shipping support for the **2026-07-28 Model Context Protocol specification**, which includes a major rework on HTTP transport going stateless, while keeping older versions of the specifications alive and mostly compatible in userland code. Find a detailed [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) in the repository, and per PR below.

## What's Changed
* [Client] Reject non-positive timeouts in Configuration by @chr-hertel in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/415
* [Server] Throw the SDK's own RuntimeException from FileSessionStore by @chr-hertel in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/404
* [Schema] Always emit {} for empty tool schema properties by @BrocksiNet in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/407
* [Server] Handle malformed JSON-RPC input graceful by @chr-hertel in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/412
* [Client] Parse CRLF- and CR-delimited SSE events by @cbcoutinho in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/401
* [Capability] Preserve optional content fields in PromptResultFormatter by @chr-hertel in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/406
* [Client][Server] Add Roots support by @wachterjohannes in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/395
* [Schema] Add resource_link content block by @cancan101 in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/400
* [Client][Schema][Server] Implement protocol version negotiation by @chr-hertel in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/403
* [Server] Add ClientGateway::supportsSampling() by @chr-hertel in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/418
* [Tests] Introduce client-server integration tests by @chr-hertel in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/419
* [Client] Implement setMaxRetries connection retries by @chr-hertel in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/413
* [Schema][Server] feat: support sampling with tools by @wWzZb in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/409
* [Capability] Gate `structuredContent` on the protocol revision by @chr-hertel in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/417
* [Schema][Server] Harden sampling tools against the spec by @chr-hertel in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/420
* [Schema] Support PHPStan/Psalm integer range types by @wWzZb in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/422
* [Schema][Server] Close the 2025-11-25 schema gaps and add the 2026-07-28 surface by @chr-hertel in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/421
* [Tests] Bump MCP Inspector to 2.2.0 by @chr-hertel in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/426
* [Schema][Client][Server] Deprecate Roots, Sampling and Logging (SEP-2577) by @chr-hertel in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/427
* [Schema][Client][Server] Close MCP Apps gaps: extension negotiation checks by @chr-hertel in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/429
* [Schema] Drop SDK-only name pattern on resources and resource templates by @chr-hertel in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/430
* Tighten the 0.8.0 CHANGELOG section by @chr-hertel in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/431
* [Examples][Tests] Make the MCP Apps example work over HTTP, and pin it by @chr-hertel in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/439
* [Capability] Stop a union type losing a branch by @chr-hertel in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/434
* [Schema] Serialize a settingless extension as an object by @chr-hertel in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/438
* [Capability] Apply a parameter's complete schema definition by @chr-hertel in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/435
* [Schema] Omit the id of an error response that never had one by @chr-hertel in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/442
* [Schema][Server] Preserve request id in JSON-RPC error responses instead of fabricating id:"" by @valeriudev in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/379
* [Schema] Stop rejecting elicitation schemas the specification allows by @chr-hertel in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/437
* [Schema] Refuse an invalid x-mcp-header annotation at definition time by @chr-hertel in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/441
* [Tests] Pin that protected resource metadata advertises no scope of its own by @chr-hertel in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/440
* [Schema][Server] Add the extensions framework SEP-2133 defines by @chr-hertel in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/443
* [Server][Tests] Serve the modern (SEP-2575) lifecycle by @chr-hertel in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/444
* [Server][Tests] Validate the standard MCP request headers (SEP-2243) by @chr-hertel in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/445
* [Server][Tests] Add the multi round-trip request flow (SEP-2322) by @chr-hertel in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/446
* [Server] Close the conformance gaps in the modern lifecycle by @chr-hertel in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/447
* [Server] Stream a modern-era response when there is something to stream by @chr-hertel in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/448
* [CI] Matrix conformance jobs over both spec revisions by @chr-hertel in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/458
* [Server] Complete the multi round-trip request surface (SEP-2322) by @chr-hertel in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/449
* [CI] Version conformance baselines and split badges per spec by @chr-hertel in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/459
* [Server] Let a server say how long its answers stay fresh (SEP-2549) by @chr-hertel in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/450
* [Server] Make subscriptions/listen actually deliver (SEP-2575) by @chr-hertel in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/451
* [Tests] Fix resources-templates-read to return a resolved URI by @chr-hertel in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/460
* [Server] Carry trace context through a request (SEP-414) by @chr-hertel in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/452
* Add badge linebreak and v1.0 roadmap items by @chr-hertel in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/461
* [Server] Enforce x-mcp-header where a request uses it (SEP-2243) by @chr-hertel in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/453
* [Server] Serve an extension's methods under the modern lifecycle by @chr-hertel in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/454
* [Server] Serve both protocol eras from one endpoint by @chr-hertel in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/455
* [Client] Speak the 2026-07-28 lifecycle by @chr-hertel in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/456
* [Docs][Examples][CI] Document and gate the 2026-07-28 lifecycle by @chr-hertel in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/457
* [Docs] Render the guides with Zensical instead of phpDocumentor by @chr-hertel in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/414
* [Server] Serve ClientGateway::elicit() under the modern lifecycle by @chr-hertel in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/466
* [Server] Log expected tool failures at debug level by @ousamabenyounes in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/433
* [Server] Log failures in CompletionCompleteHandler by @chr-hertel in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/471
* [Changelog] Restructure 0.8.0 section by @chr-hertel in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/478
* [Server] Make resource subscribe/unsubscribe errors protocol-version-aware (SEP-2164) by @chr-hertel in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/474
* [Docs] Deprecation policy, SDK tier target, and CONTRIBUTING.md by @chr-hertel in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/472
* [Server][Client] Bridge W3C trace context between HTTP headers and _meta (SEP-414) by @chr-hertel in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/473
* [Server] Restrict FileSessionStore::gc() to owned session files by @chr-hertel in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/479
* [Capability] Suppress list-changed events during the initial registry load by @chr-hertel in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/480
* [Capability] Extract shared element name/description resolution by @chr-hertel in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/481
* [Server] Keep injectable parameters out of the published inputSchema by @chr-hertel in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/482

## New Contributors
* @BrocksiNet made their first contribution in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/407
* @cbcoutinho made their first contribution in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/401
* @cancan101 made their first contribution in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/400
* @wWzZb made their first contribution in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/409
* @ousamabenyounes made their first contribution in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/433

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/compare/v0.7.1...v0.8.0

name: v0.7.0
body:
## What's Changed
* [Server] Fix completion/complete crash for plain ref/resource by @NarimanGardi in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/388
* [Server] Harden JSON-RPC input parsing against malformed input and resource exhaustion by @soyuka in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/383
* [Server] scope OAuth to resource server, not authorization server by @soyuka in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/382
* [Server] Allow pre-built instance handlers in element registration by @valeriudev in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/375
* [Schema] Fix Implementation::fromArray rejecting falsy-but-valid name/version by @DevkumarPatel in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/393
* [Client] Add client-side elicitation support by @wachterjohannes in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/371

name: v0.6.0
body:
## What's Changed
* [Server] Allow overriding the default file name pattern for Discovery by @johnhunt-lc in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/292
* [Server] force the proper Content-type for the 202 response in createJsonResponse() by @johnhunt-lc in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/295
* [Schema] fix: allow URIs without double slash in Resource and ResourceTemplate (RFC 3986) by @blackwell-systems in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/297
* fix: Cannot pass null to nullable enum parameters by @SBNTT in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/299
* [Server] Fix case sensitivity for http header by @chr-hertel in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/283
* Add PSR-3 compliant `exception` context when logging exceptions by @svenmuennich in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/300
* [Server] Add configurable session garbage collection by @chr-hertel in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/258
* [CI] Add weekly conformance run against latest upstream release by @soyuka in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/304
* [Client][Server][Schema] Bump protocol version to nov 25 by @chr-hertel in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/308
* [Server] Untangle origin tracking from Registry by @chr-hertel in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/302
* [Schema] Add title field to Resource and ResourceTemplate by @blackwell-systems in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/301
* Add title parameter to Builder::addResource() and addResourceTemplate() by @chr-hertel in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/310
* Streamline README and add conformance score badges by @chr-hertel in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/312
* [Conformance] Fix conformance score calculcation by @chr-hertel in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/313
* chore(deps): bump actions/upload-artifact from 4 to 7 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/331
* chore(deps): bump actions/download-artifact from 4 to 8 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/330
* [Server] Compose StreamableHttpTransport security middleware via defaultMiddleware() factory by @sveneld in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/307
* [Server] Allow runtime-resolved element handlers by @e0ipso in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/294
* [Schema][Server] Add MCP Apps extension (io.modelcontextprotocol/ui) support by @chr-hertel in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/281
* Document v0.6.0 changes in CHANGELOG and docs by @chr-hertel in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/311

## Breaking Changes
* Renamed `Mcp\Schema\Resource` to `Mcp\Schema\ResourceDefinition`. No alias.
* Renamed `Mcp\Capability\Registry\Loader\ArrayLoader` to `Mcp\Capability\Registry\Loader\ReflectedElementLoader`.
* Bump default protocol version to `2025-11-25`
*  Removed `ElementReference::$isManual` public property and the `bool $isManual` parameter from all `*Reference` constructors. Origin tracking is no longer carried on the element; manual-over-discovered precedence is encoded by loader execution order.
* `RegistryInterface::registerTool()`, `registerResource()`, `registerResourceTemplate()`, `registerPrompt()` lost their trailing `bool $isManual = false` parameter. Callers using positional arguments must drop the flag.
* Removed `RegistryInterface::clear()`, `getDiscoveryState()`, `setDiscoveryState()`. Rediscovery now goes through `DiscoveryLoader::load()` directly.
* `Builder::addResource()` signature changed — `$title` parameter added between `$name` and `$description`. Callers using positional arguments must switch to named arguments.
* `Builder::addResourceTemplate()` signature changed — `$title` parameter added between `$name` and `$description`. Callers using positional arguments must switch to named arguments.
* `StreamableHttpTransport` constructor: `$corsHeaders` parameter removed; CORS is now configured via `CorsMiddleware`. The `$middleware` parameter is nullable — `null` (or omitted) installs the default stack; `[]` disables all defaults. Default `Access-Control-Allow-Origin` is no longer set (was `*`).
* `ResourceDefinition::__construct()` signature changed — `$title` parameter added between `$name` and `$description`. Callers using positional arguments must switch to named arguments.
* `ResourceTemplate::__construct()` signature changed — `$title` parameter added between `$name` and `$description`. Callers using positional arguments must switch to named arguments.
* `McpResource` and `McpResourceTemplate` attribute signatures changed — `$title` parameter added between `$name` and `$description`. Callers using positional arguments must switch to named arguments.

* @johnhunt-lc made their first contribution in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/292
* @blackwell-systems made their first contribution in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/297
* @SBNTT made their first contribution in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/299
* @svenmuennich made their first contribution in https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/php-sdk/pull/300
